transport.tls: Disposable local certificate with narrowly pinned public key and local-only DNS mappings; production HTTPS origin checks retained.

limitations: Meeting-preparation scope only; this does not qualify all-module automatic synchronization or local-vault-to-hosted migration.
PowerSync Convex connector remains experimental in the pinned release.
Root application requires initial online authentication; offline hard reload preserves authored SQLite work with online recovery, not a qualified offline hosted auth/shell cache.
External production TLS/export/storage credentials and target reachability remain unqualified.
No real external Clerk/Microsoft tenant, physical device, Safari/WebKit or packaged Electron coverage in this transport suite.
Unreachable clients cannot learn new revocations immediately; TTL and reconnect validation apply.
